entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit Customer Support. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. To pull up your account, could I get your full name and order number?
Thank you, Jane. I see the order here for the VeloPro cycling shoes. Can I ask what specifically is the issue with them? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't work. They're giving me blisters, and I can't get the cleats to feel right. I just want my money back.
I'm sorry to hear they're causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay, I see they were delivered 28 days ago.

And that's no problem at all. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you're well within the window. I can process a full refund for you right away. I'm emailing you a prepaid return label now.
Fine. So I just print it and send the cycling shoes back?

That's correct. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Also, Jane, I see here that you're a VIP member with us. For the trouble you've had, I'd like to add a $20 credit to your account for your next purchase.
Whatever. I guess that's better than nothing. Thanks.
You're very welcome. The credit is active now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can get you into a more comfortable pair of shoes next time. Have a good day.
